content:
Evelyn P: Quick UX sync — support flagged multiple tickets where engineers thought the preview was lying about who gets notified because we hide suppressed channels. users expect to "see everything" that could affect routing. Marco L: We should show suppressed channels but de-emphasize them (muted pattern + icon). hiding feels like state was lost. include a short reason and who suppressed. Sana R: Accessibility caution: don't rely only on color. use a visible pattern and an aria-label on the row like "suppressed by OnCallRule until 14:00". Screenreaders should get the actor + relative time. Drew H: Runtime note: dispatch sequence can differ from configured priority due to fallbacks. frontend historically sorted by modified_at which was accidental. we need deterministic behavior. Evelyn P: Proposal: preview header shows a choice pill: [Dispatch order] [Configured priority]. default to Dispatch but make it obvious. header also contains a one-line explainer: "Dispatch order = runtime send sequence; may include fallbacks or suppressions." Marco L: Nice. Also add a compact count summary: "Notifies 2 channels, 1 suppressed" which should be announced first by SRs. counts help fast scanning. Sana R: For aria-live use polite and role=status. read counts first then the ordered list. example: "This alert will notify 2 channels: PagerDuty then Slack. Suppressed: Ops-email for 1h 12m by schedule". keep it short. Drew H: API ask: add preview_snapshot array with {id, display_name, state, suppressed_until_iso, suppressed_until_relative, actor, is_fallback}. frontend can show fallback badges. avoid client-side re-sort. Evelyn P: Keyboard flow: focus the preview -> aria-live summary reads; roving tabindex on channel rows for arrow-key nav; Enter to open details panel (suppression reason, who, link to policy). Marco L: Visual pattern: suppressed rows get subtle diagonal hatch + 2px left border accent. icon (aria-hidden) + sr-only text describing suppression. ensure contrast meets AA. Sana R: Use relative time in UI for readability ("suppressed for 2h") but keep ISO in aria-describedby for copying or logs. For SR transcripts prefer natural language like "for two hours" if possible. Drew H: Small behavior question: should preview expose historical mode (view as of trigger time)? Customers asked to repro past routing behavior. we can add a small "View as of" dropdown: Now / At trigger / Custom. Evelyn P: I like that. when in historical mode, show a subtle banner: "Showing routes as of — live suppressions not applied" to avoid confusion. Marco L: Copy nit: avoid word "route" for end-users. prefer "notify". backend docs can keep routing jargon. so aria-live should say "This alert will notify..." not "route to". Sana R: Agree. also avoid "muted" vs "suppressed" confusion. label them explicitly: "Suppressed (policy)" and "Muted (you)". provide hover details for actor and reason. Drew H: Implementation note: backend will add preview_snapshot by EOD. frontend can use that to render and a feature flag for rollout. fallback if missing: show configured priority and warn "Preview not available". ui-bot: Reminder: file follow-up with infra + api teams: https://go/redwood/ux/issue/5872 - "alert-preview: show suppressed, add preview_snapshot, historical mode" Evelyn P: Draft aria snippet to reuse: ```
This alert will notify 2 channels: PagerDuty, then Slack. Suppressed: Ops-email for 1h 12m by schedule.
``` Marco L: One more micro-ux: add a tiny "Why this ordering?" link that opens a tooltip with two lines: "Dispatch order follows runtime send sequence (includes fallbacks). Choose Configured to view user-set priority." Sana R: I'll add an accessibility test to the checklist: NVDA + VoiceOver readouts for Now vs Historical modes, and keyboard nav test steps. Drew H: I'll coordinate the API patch and include relative times. Evelyn, if you want mock images I can wire the data to a quick dev preview. Evelyn P: Please do. tagging @Sana R for a11y sign-off when mock is up. thanks team! :white_check_mark:
